name: search_sap_sops
description: Search the SAP Standard Operating Procedures Knowledge Base for exception-processing guidance including decision trees, thresholds, matching/validation methodology, and error handling.

query.description: Search query describing what SOP guidance you need

name: load_sop
description: Load the complete focused SOP for a known exception type, verbatim and with tolerances and contacts resolved. Use this instead of search_sap_sops once the exception type is classified — search returns fragments, this returns the whole procedure.

process_type.description: The classified exception type, e.g. price_variance, quantity_variance, uom_mismatch, missing_goods_receipt, missing_purchase_order, duplicate_invoice

name: search_sap_api_docs
description: Search the SAP API Documentation Knowledge Base for OData API specifications, endpoints, field descriptions, and example calls.
